study type: Observational (Case-Control) and In Vitro Mechanistic Study
outcome: Enrichment of HDAC4 and acetylated histone H3 at lysine 9 (H3K9Ac) on miR-134-5p promoter
cohort: The study involved placental samples collected from pre-eclampsia patients and healthy controls, as well as HTR8/SVneo trophoblast cell cultures.
finding: HDAC4 downregulation impaired trophoblast proliferation, invasion, and migration, while its overexpression played the opposite role, mechanistically by repressing miR-134-5p expression and promoting FOXM1 transcription, suggesting HDAC4 as a promising target for pre-eclampsia treatment.
cross-section timing: Placentas were collected from pre-eclampsia patients and healthy controls, presumably at the time of delivery.
